aggregation: Extend stable same-fragment linear bases into poorly supported cut regions. Keep all material volumes. Exact reduced inertia E.T diag(m) E; never relump after aggregation. No cross-fragment source or erasure of history.
transfer: Mass-orthogonal state projection, with explicit measured projection errors/energy; no hidden resets, energy correction impulses or loss labelled fracture.

limits.velocity_metric: mass-weighted RMS upper bound over actual material polyhedra; maximum local error remains reported

stage_A: Partial-crack opening, continuity, affine response and exact inertia controls
stage_B: Actual reached/paid crack and contact refinement
stage_C: Only after physical pass: tomato, complete performance and visible example
stop: Do not change physical or numerical model to obtain a speed pass. Diagnose and correct implementation errors. Report complete-loop evidence; no physical tomato/RL qualification from geometric component performance alone.
change: Implementation redesign only: preserve equations, material, geometry semantics, inertia, projection, timestep and validation criteria. Profile and eliminate repeated topology, operator and state reconstruction; measured matched combined-loop qualification only.
support_fraction_definition: Original row-sum nodal mass / (rho*h^3). This is a declared numerical support selector, not mass scaling or material deletion.
selection: Predeclared primary 1e-8; if primary fails response equivalence, compare the more conservative 1e-12 retaining additional modes. Both must undergo the same temporal and response screens. No unbounded threshold tuning. Secondary chosen before any dynamic accuracy runs.

velocity_criterion_approval.scope: Only cross-representation, projection and temporal-refinement deformable-material velocity criterion changes to conservative mass-weighted RMS upper bound <=0.005 m/s. Preserve maximum pointwise velocity diagnostics. All other limits unchanged, including strict same-operator CPU/GPU tolerances.

scope: Isolated implementation redesign under unchanged physical laws; no full-slice or RL qualification.

cutting.law: existing v02 ideal rate-independent cutting work; not old cohesive law

geometry: Affine-exact material polyhedra and actual saved CAD. Shallow coupon and analytic controls first; no tomato/robot qualification inherited.
authorization: User requests continuous completion through a visible physically checked tomato meeting complete RL throughput, preserving existing setup and agreed physics/accuracy.

adaptive.failure: capacity/unresolved integral rejects; never silently use coarse or drop volume
adaptive.internal_budget_note: Quadrature estimate target is <=1% of the frozen 0.1 mN denominator floor; acceptance stays 5%. Internal allocation/capacity correction after conservative zero-contact bounds exhausted initial depth.

numerical_scope.dt_25us: Only 13 ms intact tomato contact comparison passed; not adopted for cutting. Larger tested timesteps rejected.
numerical_scope.event_1ms: Matched 3 ms shallow-crack comparison passed only after preserving complete prior admissible space. Longer continuation clearance unresolved.
numerical_scope.resident_clearance: Exact CAD conservative proof executed on GPU every 250us in intact tests; unresolved proof stops and rolls back. No production change.

required_invariant: No coalescence may remove previously admissible material fields; low sampled displacement/energy errors cannot substitute for this invariant.
current_decision: Whether to authorize a separate approximate RL training model; no answer yet.
